title: Anderson 2012: regressions of MA-Y on sex, age, height, mass at each level T6-L5 (11 muscles)

imaging.plane: transverse scan plane at mid-vertebral body, T6-L5; AP/ML axes from the average angle of left/right muscle pairs
imaging.posture_detail: supine, cushion under legs (slight hip/knee flexion), arms above head

quantity.name: regression
quantity.definition: regression equation(s) predicting a muscle-geometry quantity from anthropometry

source.authors: Anderson DE, D'Agostino JM, Bruno AG, Manoharan RK, Bouxsein ML
source.sample: 100 subjects (51 M, 49 F); age/sex-stratified random sample of the Framingham Heart Study MDCT cohort

protocol.summary: Linear regression per muscle and level of the left/right-averaged QCT measurement on sex, age, height and body mass (all four always included).
how_to_simulate: Evaluate the regression equation with the subject anthropometry (units as given in data).
Compare the model quantity (as defined for the predicted variable) with the predicted value +/- SE of prediction.
protocol.notes: Evaluate the equation at the subject anthropometry to obtain the expected mean for comparison (SEE ~ between-subject SD). Table 4 quantities are NOT measured: ACSA and moment arms were computed from the measured CSA/ML-d/AP-d with literature lines of action (McGill 1993 compilation, Garner & Pandy) - keep apart from measured centroid distances. Mean values per level are only plotted (Fig. 2), not tabulated. Bold (significant) coefficients are not flagged here. Pectoralis major, serratus anterior and trapezius are included only within this regression file.
